scope.provider: scripted ACP process through the active repair loop
scope.coverage: The peer acknowledges an allowed implementation modification and returns ACP max_turn_requests with within-limit usage. The active repair loop maps this to LIMIT_EXHAUSTED and persists a RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED run plus a receipt-bound interrupted assessment; validation is not invoked. Assertions bind the MODIFIED path commitment, before/after digests, and byte count, while accepted source/head remain unchanged and no attempt remains pending. Receipt evidence records final snapshot completion, zero remaining processes, and verified sandbox cleanup. The same method also retains token-ceiling, exact-usage, malformed-usage, and refusal-after-write cases.
